name: Hibiya Wataru
source:
An underclassman who entered Habataki Academy a year behind the protagonist. He is a hot-blooded boy belonging to the Baseball Club. He seems to look up to Hazuki; he apparently asked to become his apprentice, but was coolly turned down. They say he makes continuous efforts day and night to become cool just like Hazuki.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.tokimemo-type.com/tkmkgstype/character/index.html]official website[/url]]
